knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
cojo_wet <- read.csv("data_cojo_wetlands/Wetlands_Revised_2025.csv")
print(unique(cojo_wet$Topography.Type))

cojo_wet_flat <- cojo_wet %>%
  filter(Topography.Type== "Flat") %>%
  filter(Absolute.Pct.Cover.of.J..phaeocephalus>0) %>%
  filter(NRCS.Soil.Texture == "CONCEPCION LOAMY SAND, 0 TO 5 PERCENT SLOPES") %>%
  filter(Area.in.2025..sq.ft. > 1000) %>%
  filter(Area.in.2025..sq.ft. < 100000) 

cojo_wet_flat_species <- cojo_wet_flat %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  separate_rows(Plant.List.with.Wetland.Indicators.and.Rel.Pct, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    Species = str_trim(str_extract(Plant.List.with.Wetland.Indicators.and.Rel.Pct, "^[^/]+")),
    Indicator = str_trim(
      str_match(Plant.List.with.Wetland.Indicators.and.Rel.Pct, "/\\s*([^()]+)\\s*\\(")[, 2]
    ),
    Cover = as.numeric(
      str_match(Plant.List.with.Wetland.Indicators.and.Rel.Pct, "\\(([0-9.]+)%\\)")[, 2]
    )
  )

dominant_species <- cojo_wet_flat_species %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  slice_max(Cover, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(row_id, Dominant_Species = Species,
         Dominant_Cover = Cover) %>%
  filter(Dominant_Species == "Carpobrotus edulis" | Dominant_Species == "Ehrharta calycina" | Dominant_Species == "Bromus diandrus" 
         | Dominant_Species == "Festuca perennis" | Dominant_Species == "Avena barbata" | Dominant_Species == "Annual invasive grasses")  %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  slice_max(Dominant_Cover, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>%
  ungroup()
```
